entries.title: Why my brother decided to move to Austria.
entries.body:
My brother is currently working as a waiter at Goldene Kugel in Salzburg, Austria. But why did he come to Austria?

The main reason was because of me. I am currently studying as a pupil in Salzburg, Austria. Since I would be living away from my family, I wanted my brother to be in the same city so that I would have the support of a close family member. With the help of my guardian in Austria, we began searching for a suitable job for my brother.

After about four to five months of searching, he was offered a position as a waiter at Goldene Kugel. Once the employer completed the necessary procedures, my brother received the required employment documents, including the AMS (Austrian Public Employment Service) approval, a work contract, and the necessary supporting documents. These documents were then sent from Austria to India by our guardian so that we could begin preparing his Visa D application.

In our family's situation, having a trusted guardian in Austria was extremely helpful. Our guardian assisted us with communication, collecting documents, and guiding us through the process. However, it is important to understand that every visa or residence permit application is assessed individually by the Austrian authorities. Having a guardian does not guarantee visa approval or faster processing.

If your application includes a guardian or sponsor, the relationship should be genuine and accurately documented. In our case, our guardian had known our family for many years, and we explained this relationship honestly in a supporting letter. You should never misrepresent a guardianship or create one solely to strengthen a visa application.

With my brother's employment secured and all the required documents in hand, we were finally ready to begin the Visa D application process. In the next chapter, I will explain what Visa D is and why it was the correct visa for my brother's journey.

entries.title: Understanding Visa D
entries.body:
Before beginning the application process, it is important to understand what a Visa D is and whether it is the correct visa for your situation.

A Visa D (National Visa) is a long-stay visa issued by Austria that allows eligible foreign nationals to stay in Austria for an extended period, depending on the purpose of their visit and the conditions of the visa. It is commonly issued for purposes such as employment, study, family reunification, or to facilitate entry before obtaining a residence permit, where applicable.

In my brother's case, the Visa D was the appropriate visa because he had received a valid job offer from an Austrian employer and had completed the required pre-application steps. His application was supported by the documents provided by his employer and the relevant Austrian authorities.

Why We Applied for Visa D ?

In my brother's case, we applied Visa D for Seasonal Worker Job. He received waiter job from Salzburg, Austria. As his job period/tenure is of 4 months, Visa D is the only legal option available.

Important Information About Visa D

Visa D (Visum D) is applied for those who intend to live legally in Austria from 91 days till 180 days. There are different types of Visa D: Student Visa, Work/Job Visa and Visitor Visa. Each requires specific documents to pass such as School Admission Letter for Student Visa, AMS and Work Contract for Work Visa, etc.

Documents We Had Before Applying

* Passport (Old and New, if applicable)
* Employment Contract
* AMS Approval
* Passport-size Photographs
* Health Insurance 
* Visa Application Form
* Flight Itinerary
* Emergency Contact Details
* Bank Statements and/or ITR 
* Other supporting documents

To know detail information regarding our Documentation, please refer to the following Chapters.


My Personal Tips

As per my experience at VFS, it's really important to know that you must reach at least 15 minutes before your appointment time starts. This is because of crowd at VFS Global Centre. Also, always recheck all the documents before going for the appointment. 

In order to download Checklist PDF:
  1. Go to: https://visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/aut/visa-type
  2. Select your Visa Type
  3. Select "Documents Required"
  4. Click Link text to download updated Checklist PDF by V.F.S.

As per the rules, any documents missing is considered invalid and his/her application is rejected either by V.F.S or the Embassy of Austria. Also, ensure that your full name is same in all documents. If not, issue new Stamp Paper stating about name difference in other documents and that the names refer to yourself. Get it notarized by Local Notary, then give it for Apostille. After apostille, your document is ready. Also, print out 2-3 Black and White copies of the Stamp Paper apostilled and notarized.

Summary

Understanding the purpose of Visa D before submitting an application helps you prepare the correct documents and avoid unnecessary mistakes. In the next chapter, I will explain how we collected every required document before booking the visa appointment.

entries.title: Job offer, employment contract, employer communication, and eligibility.
entries.body:
For most people applying for an Austrian Visa D for employment, securing a genuine job offer is the first and one of the most important steps. Without a valid offer from an eligible employer, it is generally not possible to proceed with the employment-based visa process.

In my brother's case, finding a job required patience and persistence. With the help of our guardian in Austria, we searched for suitable opportunities that matched his skills and experience. The search took approximately four to five months before he was finally offered a position as a waiter at Goldene Kugel in Salzburg.

Once the employer decided to hire him, they began the necessary procedures required under Austrian law. After the required approvals were obtained, my brother received his employment documents, including the work contract and other supporting documents needed for the visa application. These documents were then sent to India so that we could begin preparing his Visa D application.

Every applicant's journey is different. Some people may find employment through online job portals, recruitment agencies, personal contacts, or direct applications to employers. Regardless of how you find a job, always ensure that the employer is genuine and that all employment documents are authentic.

How We Found the Job

As he is having his guardian, he physically visited some hotels and he finally got the hotel in Salzburg. His guardian filled the form and completed everything before my brother arrived in Austria. It's important to send documents like AMS, Work Contract, etc. via Post or E-Mail. For those who don't have a guardian and/or cannot physically visit hotels for employment, they can email them well in advance with C.V. updated and Degree Certificates and other Certificates, if applicable. 

Documents Received from the Employer

☑ Employment Contract
☑ AMS Approval
☑ Security Guarantee
☑ Other Supporting Documents

Official links:

Employer Website: https://www.goldene-kugel.at/

My Personal Tips

Please find you job at the earliest. If job not received yet, contact the Embassy of Austria in New Delhi via E-Mail and Phone Number (+91 112419200). Tell them for the appointment for Job Seeking Visa. After visiting the Embassy for the appointment, they will inform you via E-Mail. After receiving accepted visa, you can visit Austria only for finding the job. After finding job, you have to come back to your home country. Then apply for residence permit and/or Visa.

Summary

Finding the right employer was the foundation of my brother's Visa D journey. Once the employment was confirmed and the required documents were issued, we could move on to preparing the complete visa application. In the next chapter, I will explain how we collected and organized all the required documents before booking the visa appointment.
